sources.text:
The northern forest line of the spruce goes through Hammastunturi Wilderness Reserve. Majestic old pine forests are found to the north of the spruce forests, and the lakes and rivers between the fell highlands call to fishing enthusiasts. A single marked hiking trail leads through this wilderness, which is also known as Hammaskaira. The trail takes visitors to a historic destination, Kultala on the River Ivalojoki, which became famous during the late 19th century gold rush. The uplands in the central parts of Hammastunturi area and paddling route on the River Ivalojoki are suitable for experienced hikers and paddlers.

Natural Features of Hammastunturi Wilderness Area
The Hammastunturi wilderness Reserve is rugger upland of Inari Lapland, jtraversed by the Ivalo River in its southern part. The area is characterized by pine forests and clear lakes.
History of Hammastunturi Wilderness Reserve and Ivalojoki River
Traces of deer hunting and gold prospecting, which are closely tied to the history of the Hammastunturi wilderness, can be seen in the wilderness reserve and along the river Ivalojoki.
